Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: I wish I had a rich patron like Artist Kweebec.

Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: Huh? Oh, no. She's not a 'dateable', whatever that means. She's just a tree who left us ages ago for some project in Howling Sands.

Entries.Name: Kweebec Merchant
Entries.Line: Some weird production about people who live in this futuristic take on the Void. It's called 'Sand Wars', I think.

Line.Text: It's coarse, and rough, and irritating... and it's spammed everywhere. The show, I mean. Not the sand.
